transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?
I won't take it, it makes me feel sick

I understand your concern, and I'm sorry to hear that the medication makes you feel unwell. It's important for your health, though, so I gently ask if you might reconsider taking it today. If not, I'll make sure your caregiver is informed so they can discuss any alternatives or adjustments with you.
I respect your decision and understand how you feel. I'll let your caregiver know so they can check in with you and discuss any concerns you might have. Take care.
